title: Pip Waits Out the Storm in the Compost Heap
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.

pages.brief: Heavy dark clouds gathering over a garden, the light turning grey.
Pip the sparrow noticing a small, dark gap in the side of a rounded compost heap.
Pip the sparrow squeezing carefully into the warm gap in the compost heap.
Heavy rain falling steadily across the garden outside the compost heap.
Pip the sparrow tucked cosily inside the gap, warm among the layers of leaves and twigs.
Strong wind blowing leaves around the outside of the compost heap.
Pip the sparrow sitting calm and still, listening to the storm outside his snug spot.
The rain easing off, drops slowing to a trickle outside the compost heap.
Pip the sparrow peeking his head out of the gap, checking the garden.
Pip the sparrow stepping out of the compost heap into a calm, sunlit garden.
